title: Introduction to Technical Communication
syllabus: The nature of technical communication. Taxonomy of technical writing: scientific writing and technical reporting. Business communication. The 5Cs of technical writing, applied to conceptual questions.

title: Grammar
syllabus: Concord (subject-verb agreement), tense, conditionals, voice, and transitions and linking words. Activity: error detection.

title: Reading
syllabus: Analysing definitions: types of definitions and methods for expanding definitions. Reading comprehension: drawing inferences from scientific texts. Structure of a research article and analysing a research article.

title: Writing
syllabus: Summary (précis) writing and abstract writing. Research writing: structure of a review paper, types of reviews, literature review, and referencing styles (IEEE, APA).

title: Interpersonal Communication
syllabus: Cross-cultural and interpersonal communication, leadership styles, Belbin's team roles, negotiation skills, Thomas-Kilmann modes of conflict management with case study analysis, and writing a statement of purpose.
